change.task: PR #700, EPIC-026 TASK-026-6 C2: ledger filename case
change.origin: The shared CbC tooling (cbc-r7-bb830b2) names a ledger from the artifact path with case kept. Ten Casper ledgers used lowercase names, and check-casper-claims kept a lowercase exception for scripts/casper-soak/Cargo.toml. A lookup of these ledgers worked on a case-insensitive filesystem only.

commits.change: The ledger slug is the artifact path with each run of non-alphanumeric ASCII characters replaced by one hyphen and with leading and trailing hyphens removed. The lowercase exception for scripts/casper-soak/Cargo.toml is removed. This is the slug rule of the shared tooling.

change.ledger_bytes: The renamed ledgers keep their bytes. Their recorded artifact id fields keep the lowercase value.
change.symlinks: The ten matching symlinks in docs/cbc-evidence are renamed and point to the renamed ledgers.
change.unchanged: The claim document, the claim specification header, and all other audit logic are unchanged. The historical snapshot runs/casper-authority-provider-20260928-01/previous-records/scripts-casper-soak-cargo-toml.md is unchanged.

slug_equivalence.method: For each of the 127 artifacts that the eight CLAIM-CASPER-SOAK claims list, compare the old auditor slug with the new slug.
slug_equivalence.result: 126 artifacts give the same slug. scripts/casper-soak/Cargo.toml changes from scripts-casper-soak-cargo-toml to scripts-casper-soak-Cargo-toml, and its ledger is renamed to match.

exact_case_lookup.method: For each of the 127 artifacts, require a tracked ledger whose name equals the new slug, compared with case.

claim_audit.result: CLAIM-CASPER-SOAK-001 and -002 pending, -003 to -008 discharged, claim_discharge pending. These are the statuses of the claim specifications, which this change does not edit.

regression_tests.command: cargo test --locked -p casper-soak --test models --test claims --test interruption

static.clippy: cargo clippy --locked -p casper-soak --bin check-casper-claims -- -D warnings passed

shared_gate.tooling: top-level-gitlab-profile cbc-r7-bb830b2 (bb830b285a3dc831a34826975b18a4f4a296b011), extracted from the tag
shared_gate.command: cbc.sh discharge --strict --json over the 408 mandatory files
shared_gate.result: 408 rows, 179 gaps, exit 4. The per-file statuses are identical to the run before the renames.

acceptance_request.scope: One acceptance covers the slug change in check-casper-claims.rs and the ten ledger renames.

expected_gate_state: check-casper-claims passes because it reports CLAIM-CASPER-SOAK-001 as pending. The check-casper-claims.rs ledger keeps the digest 3a5f28ef until a maintainer accepts this package.
